name: makueni-ledger-sidecar
description: Small HTTP sidecar that anchors report-event hashes to a Hedera Consensus Service topic on testnet, using Hedera's JavaScript SDK. The Flask backend talks to this over HTTP via LEDGER_BACKEND=hedera_sidecar instead of calling Hedera directly, since Hedera's JS SDK is more mature/better documented than the Python options (see Section 5 of the spec).
